source_policy.notion: read-only decision/knowledge context; no writes performed

architecture.runtime: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite frontend; Node.js + Express + tsx backend
architecture.bootstrap: server.ts mounts auth, vault, pipeline, gateways, evolution, ledger, admin, bot and webhook routers; Vite middleware in dev and static dist in production; binds 127.0.0.1
architecture.flow: channel webhook -> normalization -> deterministic rules -> Gemini/fallback -> privacy/ledger -> shadow queue/HITL -> outbox when approved
architecture.persistence: SQLite-backed domain stores and audit/ledger/shadow state; isolated test SQLite under .tmp/

technical_decisions.decision: shadow/HITL for risky or non-personal traffic
release gate separates code evidence from runtime evidence
formal ADR files not found in docs/
technical_decisions.evidence: tracked docs inventory; decisions are in handoffs/AGENTS.md

api_and_webhooks.auth_contract: /api/admin requires admin; /api/pipeline and /api/evolution and /api/ledger require operator; /api/gateways requires auditor; bearer or HttpOnly session cookie
api_and_webhooks.other: auth, vault/admin credentials, gateways, ledger, bot, evolution and admin routes are enumerated in src/server/*/routes.ts
api_and_webhooks.webhook_security: Evolution fails closed with x-evolution-webhook-secret and constant-time comparison; Bale validates x-telegram-bot-api-secret-token when configured.

security_contracts: Admin master credential is not returned to API/frontend.
Privacy modes scrub/avoid persistence for personal or ephemeral high-privacy contexts.
Do not put secrets, raw user messages, patient data or private network details in Issue/PR/logs.

testing_and_release.npm_run_release_readiness: PASS as code gate; reports RUNTIME_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED, not deployment readiness
